title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I am a 33 year old Indian male from Mumbai, staying in workig in Abu Dhabi. I have pproximately 20-22 years of Qada namaz. I came across a site called www.islamicacademy.com giving the following easy way of praying For the people who have many years of missed Salahs. There is a way to pray them quickly. Following instructions have four exeptions and has all Fards and Wajibs for a complete Salat. Please pray your Qaza as soon as possible. Even of you could pray one days Qaza Salahs every day which are only 20 rakahs (3 wajib witr), please do it. It only takes few mins to perform 20 rakahs according to the following instructions. 1) In Ruku and Sajdah instead of reciting "Subhaana Rabbiyal Azeem" and "Subhaana Rabbiyal A'la" three times, say it only once. But make sure do not leave Ruku poster untill the Meem (M) of Azeem has been said properly. Similarly do not leave the posture of Sajdah until Ala has been said completely. Just make sure to say these Tasbeehaat properly and do not rush. 2) In third and four Rakah of Fard Salah instead of reciting the whole Soorah Fatiha say, "Subhan Allah" three times and go to Ruku, . Make sure "Subhan Allah" has been recited three times properly, do not rush. This exeption is only for Fard. In third rakah of Witr it's a must to recite full Soorah Fatiha followed by at least three ayahs of Quran or a soorah (as we usually do in first and second rakah). 3) In last Qaidah (when we sit for Attahyyat) before Salam, after Attahyyat instead of full Durood and Dua just say, "Allah Humma Salle Ala Sayedena Mohammad Wa Aalihi", then finish the Salat with Salam. Dua is not a must here. 4) In Witr, instead of full Dua-e-Qunoot just say "Rabbigh Fir Lee" one or three times. (Fatawa Rizvia, Part 3, Page 622) Can you please advise if the above method can be followed sagely 2924 views Q. I am a man of 61 (according to solar year). answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 159171 Country: India Title: When to read Sana and when not? Question: Please clarify in the light of Quran and Hadith I am confused. Please tell all situation's when reading Sana is mandatory and when one should not read Sana, if anyone joins Jamat late behind Imam. Someone told me that, if Imam is in ruku, then we should not read Sana and join Imam immediately. If Imam is reciting Surah Fatiha or Quran, then shall we read Sana or skip it. Please tell in other situations as well. Answer ID: 159171 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 666/608/M=6/1439) If someone joins the jamat at a time when the imam had already started qirat then the person should stand silently after joining the salah and should not read Sana . And if he joins the jamat at a time when the imam had finished reading qirat in the first rakah and bowed down in ruku then if he hopes that he shall get the imam in ruku after doing takbir tahrimah and reading Sana then he should read Sana and then join him in ruku, but if he fears that the imam shall raise his head from the ruku then in such a case he may leave Sana and join the imam in ruku. And if someone is masbuq i.e. he has missed one or more rakah then he should join the imam immediately and when he stands for completing his missed rakahs he should read Sana first and then do the other things. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
